results.details: support cases additively extend the reauthentication API contract
create and reply require CSRF and durable encrypted idempotency
replies bind body and If-Match to the exact case version
request scope is reauthorized against the current active membership in PostgreSQL
members cannot list, read, or reply to another requester's case
case and message metadata are protected by forced tenant RLS
subject and message plaintext never enter PostgreSQL
case transitions are database-fenced and closed cases are immutable
contract support entitlement is bounded and frozen at case creation
gateway has an exact support route family rather than a broad prefix
support lifecycle events additively extend SessionReauthenticated
events carry references and hashes, never support plaintext
both event fixtures are deterministic and content-addressed
integration coverage includes idempotency substitution, tenant-wide denial, CAS, SLA, and plaintext-reference checks
